cli.description: The wikiwright binary under packages/cli: verbs, envelopes, the shell half of the Writer, modules and trust, freshness.

kernel.description: The kernel of @wikiwright/core: parse, identity, types, shapes, the judge, routing, the Writer, generation, search.

kit.description: The shipped domain kit @wikiwright/kit-code, and this bundle as its consumer.

meta.description: The wiki about the wiki: charter, decisions, reviews.

repo.description: The repository around the packages: the scripts, the tools, the gate, the tests.

stdlib.description: The standard library under packages/core/src/stdlib: claims, relations, entries.

architecture-overview.description: The engine's shape: the four layers and how a verdict flows through them; anchored to the entry points that define them. This bundle lives in the repository it documents, so origin is `.`.

charter.description: The bundle's charter: pure intention and scope, loaded every session.
charter.use_when: Exactly one page — meta/charter.md: the bundle's intention and scope, loaded every session. Not the agent operating manual (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md).
charter.avoid_when: Anything that is a setting, a decision record, or content.

code-concept.description: A cross-cutting mechanism of the engine that lives in many places: an invariant, a law, a data shape spanning subsystems.

decision.description: A decision record of the engine, numbered D-nnn, citing the documents and pages that carry its evidence.

integration.description: An external system the engine talks to, and the contract with it; anchored to the code that speaks it.

ops-reference.description: Lookup tables for the engine: the envelope and exit codes, environment variables, repository scripts; anchored to the code that defines them.

quickstart.description: Install, build, and verify the engine from a fresh clone; anchored to the files its commands come from.

source-map.description: Directory-to-purpose lookup for the wikiwright repository, anchored to the paths it lists.

subsystem.description: One owned system of the engine, read at the pin and anchored to the directory it covers.

testing-guide.description: How the engine's tests are organized, run, and written: the two runners, temp copies, the kit-code helper.
